newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Mulia units in 200 bln rph bond issue.
newsitem.headline: Mulia units in 200 bln rph bond issue.

text.p: Two subsidiaries of Indonesian ceramics and glass maker PT Mulia Industrindo announced on Monday each will issue 100 billion rupiah seven-year straight bonds to strengthen their working capital.
"The proceeds would solely be used to strengthen the financial performance of each subsidiary," Mulia Industrindo director Tony Surjanto told reporters.
Both subsidiaries, glass maker PT Muliaglass and ceramics manufacturer PT Muliakeramik Indahraya, are 100-percent owned by Mulia Industrindo.
The firms said in statements that both of the bond issues would be listed on the Surabaya Stock Exchange on June 16 and that the bonds rates would be finalised on May 26.
Underwriters of the both bond issues are PT BT Prima Securities Indonesia and PT Trimegah Securindolestari.
Muliaglass is Indonesia's second largest float glass manufacturer after PT Asahimas Flat Glass and the largest glassware manufacturer.
Muliakeramik is the country's largest ceramic tile producer with a 28-percent domestic market share.
Mulia Industrindo posted a consolidated net profit of 113.12 billion rupiah in 1996 against 68.52 billion rupiah in 1995.
